name: Omigawa Hitomi
source:
Likes: Family, cute things
Dislikes: Being insecure
Hobbies: Collecting miscellaneous goods

Kenji's childhood friend, she calls herself his wife and so does everyone at school. When she learns that Nao was able to move in with Kenji and Misaki by claiming to be his fiancée, she does the same thing and moves in together with them.
